cost_treatments.not_applicable_baseline: No new adaptation action is represented; output is an unadapted or current-practice damage estimate.
cost_treatments.explicitly_zero_unpriced: Adaptation changes damages but its implementation cost is set to zero; net welfare and net SCC claims are blocked.
cost_treatments.embedded_in_total: The source total already includes relevant adaptation expenditures and residual impacts; adding a separate cost is prohibited.
cost_treatments.explicit_modeled: Adaptation and residual-damage components are explicitly modeled inside a total-cost decision rule.
cost_treatments.unresolved: Documentation does not establish cost inclusion; net claims are blocked.

accounting_rules: Never add an adaptation cost to a source total marked embedded_in_total or explicit_modeled.
Never label explicitly_zero_unpriced or unresolved scenarios as net damages or net SCC.
A cost level is not an SCC: run the same adaptation decision rule on matched baseline and marginal-emissions-pulse paths and difference annual total costs.
Do not allocate aggregate literature costs to crops, regions, years, or adaptation scenarios without a source-supported mapping.
Keep transfers, indirect user costs, physical repair costs, and welfare losses tagged separately when the source permits.
Use a common price year, currency, socioeconomic path, and discounting convention only after source-specific normalization.
